svg.title: Adiabatic flash at 250 kPa: K at the converged T = 56.3 °C
svg.text: Adiabatic flash at 250 kPa: K at the converged T = 56.3 °C
High-temperature DePriester chart (nomograph), redrawn from Wankat Eq. 2-30 / Table 2-3
Mark p = 250 kPa on the pressure scale (left).
Mark the converged drum temperature T = 56.3 °C on the right scale.
Join the two marks with a straight edge (repeat for each trial T).
Redrawn from the correlation; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
